name: Create and email PDF invoices from Google Sheets rows

parameters.content:
## Create and email PDF invoices from Google Sheets

### How it works
For freelancers and small businesses that keep invoice lines in a Google Sheet. Each row is one line; rows with the same `invoice_number` become one invoice, and only rows with the status `ready` are used.

1. Reads every row of the sheet.
2. Checks the required fields and groups the lines into one invoice per number. If a row is incomplete or a date isn't `YYYY-MM-DD`, it stops before anything is sent and lists the rows.
3. Renders each invoice with the verified Dynamic Document API node. The template computes line totals, VAT and the amount due.
4. Emails the PDF with Gmail and sets the rows to `sent`, so the next run skips them.

If Gmail fails partway through, the rows stay `ready` and a rerun sends the earlier invoices again. Check your sent folder first.

### Setup
1. Import the [sample sheet](https://dynamicdocumentapi.com/assets/tutorials/invoices-sheet.csv) into Google Sheets. Keep the date columns as plain text.
2. Install the community node `@dynamic-document-api/n8n-nodes-dynamic-document-api` (verified, tested with 0.1.1): nodes panel, search **Dynamic Document API**, **Install node**.
3. In the [dashboard](https://app.dynamicdocumentapi.com/signup), add an invoice template from the gallery and create an API key. A free test key adds a TEST watermark.
4. Connect Google Sheets, Gmail and Dynamic Document API. Pick your sheet in both Google Sheets nodes and your template in the PDF node. Picking the sheet in **Mark rows as sent** resets it: set **Map Automatically** and match on `row_number` again.
5. Enter your details in **Set your business details**.

### Customization
Swap the manual trigger for a Schedule Trigger, or add Google Drive to keep a copy of each PDF. [Step-by-step tutorial](https://dynamicdocumentapi.com/docs/tutorials/invoice-pdfs-google-sheets-n8n)

## 1. Read your details and the sheet
Your company and bank details, then every row of the sheet. Edit **Set your business details** once.

## 2. Build the invoices
Groups the `ready` rows by invoice number. Stops before sending if a row is incomplete.

## 3. Create and email the PDFs
Renders each invoice from your template and sends it as an attachment.

## 4. Mark the rows as sent
Matches each row on `row_number`. After you pick the sheet, set **Map Automatically** and `row_number` again.

## Test with your own address
The sample sheet uses `example.com` addresses. Put your own address in **To** for the first run.
